limits.note: converted to time at 140 kt approach speed (assumption); x1.25 wet/low visibility (assumption); applied to arrivals on the same physical runway (both ends)
workbook has no B757 row; treated as Heavy (conservative)
added on top of workbook wake times when METAR shows wet surface or visibility < 3 SM
never planned below; hold allowed only up to the extra fuel above alternate + final reserve
by gate size class of the aircraft
no trip fuel in the data; holding fuel is checked against extra fuel instead

limits.value: 45 min of holding (workbook default) unless the wave states it
limits.note: fuel.extra_min of each flight as built by the wave builder

report = scheduled departure - 60 min (assumption); PLT-CREW-DUTY: landing slot + taxi-in (or alternate arrival for a diversion) must be within the duty end. A flight whose earliest possible in-block is already past the duty end is an unavoidable duty bust (data): reported in the check detail, never a violation. Otherwise the rule fails iff the plan's arrival is past the duty end. Skipped when the departure time is unknown
overtime is allowed (GND-CREW-DUTY reports it, never vetoes) and costs 1.5x in Ground utility; changed from v1 where any overtime was illegal
decision time is T0: a flight landing before T+20 keeps its scheduled gate; the remote stand is exempt (assumption, always staffed)

limits.value: arrivals per runway per rolling 60 min <= max_runway_ops_per_hour / active_runways
limits.note: applied to every real physical runway (strip); fixed queue arrivals count but only wave flights can be vetoed; arrivals only; departures not modelled (relaxation)

limits.value: real runway ids, headings and METAR
limits.note: real runways are used instead of the workbook active_runways count, which is only the divisor of the capacity cap; crosswind/tailwind limits from FAA Order 8400.9 / AFM
not in workbook; spare_gates from workbook remain binding; exempt from gate notice
maximum en-route speed reduction a pilot may use to absorb delay
45 min at large hubs, 35 min at medium/small hubs

limits.value: Large hub: active_runways 4, max_runway_ops_per_hour 90 -> 22.5 arrivals/runway/h, min_turnaround 45 min, gates 150, spare gates 3; wave models min(gates, 12) gates (+ remote stand)
